rows.text: SPA, date line Riyadh 25 Jumada II 1426 / 31 July 2005: a royal order 'issued today' (صدر أمر ملكي اليوم), Royal Order A/193 dated 25/6/1426 AH, opens 'نحن فهد بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود ملك المملكة العربية السعودية' and creates an excellent-rank post of special adviser in the Riyadh Region emirate.
rows.locator: Date line; order number and date; preamble; item First; trailer 1456 (14:56 Makkah time)

rows.text: The order's recital cites a submission by 'صاحب السمو الملكي ولي العهد نائب رئيس مجلس الوزراء رئيس الحرس الوطني', without a name, and its signature block reads 'فهد بن عبدالعزيز' followed by 'عنه / عبدالله بن عبدالعزيز' (on his behalf, Abdullah bin Abdulaziz).
rows.locator: Royal Order A/193, recital and signature block
